card.name: Bad Reaction to Simochi
card.officialEffect: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, any effect of increasing your opponent's Life Points is changed to inflict the same amount of points in damage to your opponent's Life Points.

design.targeting: A face-up copy controlled by the opposing team converts an effect LP gain targeting the other team; a team's own Simochi does not convert that team's own gain.
design.replacement: The gain is replaced by damage to the same team in the exact proposed amount; the adapter emits a plan and does not mutate LP.
design.copies: Multiple copies are non-cumulative: one or more face-up copies still convert the gain exactly once.
design.negation: Negated copies are ignored; if all copies are negated or face-down, the gain remains unchanged.
design.idempotency: Duplicate event receipts are checked before the LP snapshot so retries remain idempotent after later state advancement.
design.integration: Pure replacement adapter only; central LP transaction pipeline integration remains pending explicit M61 handoff.

tests: both teams fielded: opposing copy applies
duplicate delivery remains idempotent after LP snapshot advances

ci.initialFailure: The initial 18-test run exposed inconsistent fixture LP (event snapshot 7000 vs default team LP 8000), causing 13 failures before the behavior assertions.
ci.correction: Aligned the structural fixture with its LP event snapshot, added symmetric-team, post-advance idempotency and malformed negation UID cases. A new CI run is required to certify the correction.

certification.reason: Adapter-only; no resolver, metadata, certification, manifest, allowlist or catalog changes.

limitations: The adapter returns a replacement plan; it does not apply LP changes or alter another effect's resolution.
Tests use structural TagDuel fixtures, not the complete LP transaction pipeline.
No live Discord gateway validation or certification is claimed.
